messages:
Alex Chen: Morning — async check-in. What I did: finalized the benchmark post for the new prompt templates and uploaded screenshots to the Bench Drive. Blockers: waiting on final pricing blurb from product. Today: prepping the launch checklist and pinging eng for final perf numbers. Link to calendar + sheet: https://go.redwood/launch-sheet :rocket:
Maria Gomez: Uploaded the content calendar row for the launch (row 42). Added proposed social copy and AB variants. Need hero image + final CTA. @designs-team can you confirm asset timeline? :eyes:
Dan Patel: Quick CR ping — PR #452 (marketing/tracking) ready for review. Adds analytics events for post-click funnel. Should be a quick pass, then merge. Leaving comments now.
Sophia Li: Eng update: ran a focused load test on Dedicated staging (64 GPU shards). 95th perc p99 latency stable under expected load, but one flaky integration test in staging that intermittently times out. Investigating; likely a race in KV cache warmup.
Alex Chen: Can you paste the failing test log here when you have it? Also, what's your risk for the canary window?
Sophia Li: Paste logs:
```
[2026-03-17T08:12:03Z] test_inference_stream_timeout: Timeout after 30s waiting for token stream
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File \"tests/test_stream.py\", line 78, in test_inference_stream_timeout
    assert stream.recv(timeout=30)
TimeoutError: no events
```
Root cause note: intermittent backpressure on the batcher when cache miss rate spikes. Mitigant: temp increase of batcher concurrency for canary.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: staging at 14:00 PST. Canary policy currently set to 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 90m unless manual abort. :white_check_mark:
Maria Gomez: Marketing blocker: need final quote from Evelyn for the hero card and the one-liner for the benchmark callout. Also need confirmation on whether we push the benchmark blog at 9am PT or 10am PT.
Evelyn (CTO): Quote sent via DM to Maria: "Our focus on predictable inference is what lets teams ship with confidence — lower latency, lower cost, fewer surprises." Use it for hero + tweet. Post timing: prefer 9am PT to sync with analyst windows.
Maria Gomez: Added Evelyn's quote to the hero and updated publish time to 09:00 PT. Thanks!
Dan Patel: I reviewed PR #452, left two tiny comments (naming + one test assert). Should be green after fixes. Tagging @Alex Chen for final merge. :thumbsup:
Alex Chen: Will merge after the two comments are addressed. Also note: please add a short note in the launch doc under 'rollback plan' about reverting analytics flag if we see spike in error rates.
Sophia Li: Canary config suggestion: start 10% for 30m, 30% for 30m, 100% after 30m if p50/p95 stable and error rate <0.5%. I increased batcher concurrency for canary to avoid the timeout spikes. Need ops approval.
ops: Approved the canary policy and the temporary batcher concurrency bump. We'll watch the metrics and hold if p95 increases by >20% or errors >0.5%.
Maria Gomez: Design update: @designs-bot — hero image in progress, can deliver by 17:00 PT with final copy. If we need earlier, tell me now.
designs-bot: Hero mock v3 will be ready by 17:00 PT. If copy is final sooner, we can try a 15:00 PT delivery.
Alex Chen: Final ask for teams — drop any last-minute launch ops items into the sheet under the 'Launch Day Ops' tab before 11:00 PT. I'll consolidate and send out the final runbook.
Maria Gomez: Noted. I'll put social scheduling notes + canalization plan in the sheet.
Dan Patel: Merging PR once tests pass. Will ping here when done.
Sophia Li: I'll run one more perf smoke in staging after the deploy-bot staging push. If I see anything odd I'll call for hold.
Alex Chen: Thanks everyone — small quick sync. If anything urgent, DM. :raised_hands:
